verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Logseq Sync syncing up to 10 graphs between one user's Desktop, Android and iOS devices, but nothing documents sharing a graph with collaborators or real-time co-editing with conflict handling. Community reports of team use through GitHub, Syncthing or shared iCloud folders are user-side workarounds, not a product capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can share a vault or space with collaborators and edit notes together without stepping on each other's changes
